chris.pageDescription: Senior Full-stack Developer at Pink Pollos. Builds systems that work.
chris.subtitle: Builds systems that work. No excuses, no drama. Just code that does what it's supposed to do.
bio: Over 10 years of experience building scalable applications. From startup MVP to enterprise platform — Chris has built it.
Specialty: reducing complex problems to elegant solutions. No overengineering, no shortcuts. Code that works, is readable, and keeps working.
Pragmatic, direct, and allergic to bullshit. If something can't be done, you'll hear it immediately. If it can be done, it's ready tomorrow.

dennis.tagline: I am the one who knocks
dennis.pageDescription: Agile Coach and Team Manager at Pink Pollos. Makes teams better.
dennis.subtitle: Makes teams better. No methodology drama, just results. When your team is stuck, I fix it.
bio: Teams that are stuck, processes that don't work, organizations struggling with change — Dennis fixes it. Not with frameworks and certifications, but with common sense.
15+ years of experience guiding development teams. From chaotic startups to sluggish enterprises. The approach differs, the result doesn't: teams that deliver.
No Scrum police, no Agile theater. Just: clear communication, focus on results, and the courage to say what no one wants to hear.

whatDoYouDo.question: What exactly do you do?
whatDoYouDo.answer: We provide senior developers and agile experts who integrate directly into your team. No trainees, no long onboarding periods. You get experienced professionals who add value to your project from day one.

howFast.question: How quickly can you start?
howFast.answer: Usually within 1-2 weeks. We deliberately keep capacity available for new projects. For urgent matters, we'll look together at what's possible — sometimes we can switch within a few days.

rates.question: How do your rates work?
rates.answer: We work with fixed daily rates, no surprises afterwards. Rates depend on the assignment and duration. In a first conversation, we discuss what you need and what it costs.

remote.question: Do you work remotely?
remote.answer: Yes, we work fully remote or hybrid, depending on what works best for your team. We're used to async communication and have set up our tooling accordingly.

team.question: Can you provide a whole team?
team.answer: Absolutely. Through our inner circle, we have access to proven specialists in various disciplines. From a complete squad to specific expertise — we arrange it.

guarantee.question: What if it doesn't click?
guarantee.answer: Then we stop. No fuss, no long notice periods. We believe in fit, not contractual obligations. If it doesn't work, that's a waste of time for both parties.
